facts.fact: Meridiam and Raxio say Raxio's first flagship data centre is in Uganda and operating as a neutral facility for customers; Meridiam invests $48m in Raxio's network (document published 2021-03-29, which gives no opening date).

note: Tier III statement is generic to all Raxio facilities, not naming the Uganda site, so no tier3 fact; Ethiopia and DRC sites are not UGA.
